text:
Rita: dropping a small sketch for the compact metrics tile. Main tradeoffs: chips vs dropdown for legend, where to put the unit badge, smoothing exposure, and how to indicate extreme values. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/mini-proto

Omar: chips are readable but overflow on narrow widths. idea: show 3 chips then a "+n" pill that opens a panel with checkboxes. keeps context and saves space.

Lea: agree. make the +n pill keyboard-focusable and announce like "More series: 4 hidden". also chips need 44px hit targets.

A11yBot: accessibility notes:
- +n panel: role=dialog (aria-modal=false), manage focus, restore focus on close.
- Chips: aria-pressed states and contrast >= 4.5:1.
- Unit badge: role=button, aria-haspopup=menu, clear label ("Units: auto").

Rita: units: per-tile badge with Auto / Raw / SI / Human in micro-menu. default from metadata. tooltip shows full unit.

Omar: smoothing: default light smoothing, but show raw values on hover; include a tilde icon in legend for smoothed series that toggles smoothing per series.

Lea: outliers: current clamp at 99.9pct with a caret showing count. prefer whisker to percentile + an overflow caret that opens a list of top outliers and an expand-to-full-scale action. CSV exports must include raw values.

A11yBot: overflow caret must be role=button with aria-describedby linking to the outlier list. the list needs headings and keyboard nav.

Rita: proposed decisions: 1) legend: chip-collapsible with 3-preview + +n panel; 2) units: badge with micro-menu, metadata default; 3) smoothing: default smoothed + raw-on-hover + per-series toggle; 4) outliers: whisker + overflow caret + expandable full-range view. anyone object?

Omar: approve :+1:

Lea: approve, will file a11y checklist PR with focus flows and ARIA examples.

Rita: thanks all 44d Ill update Figma and post follow-up once screens are in.
